pose_convention: Roblox: position (x, y, z) -> (-x, z, y), so the front is -Z (LookVector). *_angles_roblox_deg
go to CFrame.Angles(math.rad(x), math.rad(y), math.rad(z)); body_cframe_roblox is the
same Body CFrame as CFrame.new(table.unpack(t)), relative to the prop pivot or HumanoidRootPart.
For a cat with `scale` s (Ragdoll, Maine Coon 1.2) multiply every pose position by s.

upright.note: Stands on the hind legs, the base of the bin traps. Working cats sit on body B instead (CatCafe_Cat_<Name>_Sit).

carried.note: Cradled across the chest, facing the character's left, so the camera behind the player sees the cat side on. Relative to the HumanoidRootPart centre (R15: 3 studs above the floor).

lick.note: Sitting, washing a paw: the left front paw up at the mouth, head tipped down to it (Derek 2026-10-27: the paw-up sit is licking a paw).

loaf.note: Lying down, belly on the floor, paws folded under and turned out so they show at the sides.

sleep.note: The loaf with the head down and turned, tail curled round the side.

eat.note: Standing, head down to a bowl in front of the front paws.

work_barista.note: Standing at work, the right paw held out with a takeaway cup (Held_Barista in LegF2).

work_waiter.note: Standing at work, a tray with a cup and a slice of cake held out at the left side (Held_Waiter in LegF1).

work_greeter.note: Standing at work, waving the left paw up and out; nothing held.

work_entertainer.note: Standing at work, a microphone held up under the chin in the right paw (Held_Entertainer in LegF2, leaning in to the mouth), the left paw down at its side.

CatCafe_VFX_ShinySparkle.use: ParticleEmitter.Texture for the ShinySparkle preset; tint with Color

suggested_emitter.parent: the cat's Body (emits from its box)

CatCafe_Tex_LeafLitter.use: a Texture on the Top face of every Floor-tagged part while the Leaf Litter floor style (woods_leaf_litter) shows; removed with the style

suggested_texture.part: Color (160, 100, 50) and Material Ground stay under it, so the floor keeps its catalog look where the texture hasn't loaded

assets.name: CatCafe_Cat_Tabby_Sit
assets.studio: Body B, sitting up: clone this instead of CatCafe_Cat_Tabby for a cat resting in the cafe or working at a station. Put the role's outfit pieces on its Outfit_<Piece> Attachments. Parts with their own joint (Head with the eyes and ears, Tail, LegF1, LegF2) are Models pivoted at the joint, for poses (manifest cat_poses). The Head's Attachment Carry (above the ears) takes a carried tray or coin bag's pivot (F90).

assets.name: CatCafe_Cat_Tabby_Work
assets.studio: Body S, standing at work (Derek 2026-11-02): clone this instead of CatCafe_Cat_Tabby_Sit for a cat working at a station, in the sitting role outfit on its Outfit_<Piece> Attachments. Its front legs are arms (LegF1 the cat's left, LegF2 its right) and LegB1 and LegB2 its legs, each a Model pivoted at its joint, with the Head (eyes and ears inside, Attachment Carry above the ears) and Tail. Each role's held thing is a Model inside an arm, pivoted at the paw: Held_Barista (a cup) and Held_Entertainer (a microphone) in LegF2, Held_Waiter (a tray with a cake) in LegF1; keep the one for the cat's role and remove the others (the greeter holds nothing). Turn the arms with the role's pose (manifest cat_poses work_<role>), which holds the thing upright.

The Head's Attachment Carry (above the ears) takes a carried tray or coin bag's pivot (F90). Glowing eyes: set the parts of the Eye1 and Eye2 Models to Neon. Prop: the Head prop is the child Model <name>_Prop (and <name>_Prop_Glass, Glass) and rides the Head (its Model is inside the Head Model); PropSlot = Head, so CatPose.dress leaves that slot's role piece off. Second prop: the Face prop is the child Model <name>_Prop2 and rides the Head (inside the Head Model); PropSlot2 = Face, so the role piece in that slot stays off too (F71). The child Model <name>_Tail_Glow hangs inside <name>_Tail, pivoted where it hangs, and rides the Tail (Follows Tail).

assets.name: CatCafe_Decor_DoorSign
assets.studio: #1140 (door-sign.md): the cafe's one Open/Closed sign. Pivot at its hook: place it on the cafe shell's SignHook attachment, unturned. OPEN (root parts) faces the street; at nightfall turn the whole sign 180 about Y so the CLOSED face (_Closed Model, with its _Moon_Bulb) does. _Hanger (hook, twine, board) always shows.

assets.name: CatCafe_Park_RescueTree
assets.pivot: base center; the Branch pivots at its root on the trunk (part_pivots_roblox)

stuck_pose.note: Draped across the Branch between the trunk and the leaf tuft, facing the tree's front, looking down at the player (the engineer's #200; along the branch put the longer cats' heads and tails in the trunk and the leaves). assets.studio: Rescue trap tree (shake_catch). To wobble, rotate the Branch about its part_pivots_roblox point (set Branch.PivotOffset there if the import centres it). Put the cat at stuck_pose, then weld its Body to the Branch so it moves with it. CollisionFidelity Hull on the Trunk.

assets.studio: Tier 10, the Medieval Castle (next-areas plan section 3, #4067). Place it at the area's centre on its floor, camp side -Z, like the Snowy set. Packed earth right out to the walls, cobbles, the field's sand and the keep's flags over it. Nothing invisible stands inside the area: the only _Barrier is the 30 high ring in the border's wall band, all round but the 24 stud way in at z -280, starting 0.8 behind the border's faces. The moat is a kerb 0.7 high (a step, not a wall) round shallow _Water; the drawbridge and the postern's plank bridge are 0.9 up with a ramp at each end. The curtain wall and the keep's walls collide; the tilt fence is a low rail to hop. Torch flames are _Glow, windows _Pane, the drawbridge's chains _Decor. The rescue spots (points_roblox trap_haystack, trap_barrel, trap_banner_pole, trap_awning, trap_helmet) carry their piece's turn.

assets.name: CatCafe_Cat_Popcorn_Work

assets.name: CatCafe_Cat_Elf_Work
assets.studio: Body S, standing at work (Derek 2026-11-02): clone this instead of CatCafe_Cat_Elf_Sit for a cat working at a station, in the sitting role outfit on its Outfit_<Piece> Attachments. The Head's Attachment Carry (above the ears) takes a carried tray or coin bag's pivot (F90). Glowing eyes: set the parts of the Eye1 and Eye2 Models to Neon. Prop: the Head prop is the child Model <name>_Prop (and <name>_Prop_Glass, Glass) and rides the Head (its Model is inside the Head Model); PropSlot = Head, so CatPose.dress leaves that slot's role piece off. Second prop: the Back prop is the child Model <name>_Prop2 and rides the Body; PropSlot2 = Back, so the role piece in that slot stays off too (F71). The child Model <name>_Horn_Glow hangs inside <name>_Prop, pivoted where it hangs, and rides what that prop rides. The child Model <name>_Tail_Ember_Glow hangs inside <name>_Tail, pivoted where it hangs, and rides the Tail (Follows Tail). The child Model <name>_Scale_Glow hangs inside <name>_Prop2, pivoted where it hangs, and rides what that prop rides.
